title: cite review open — stdout contract
description: The JSON `cite review open <path>` prints to stdout: the new review run id, the artifact's frozen provenance (stored content hash, best-effort git HEAD sha which is null when the workspace is not a git repo, tool schema version = PRAGMA user_version), and the prior (choice_key, summary) pairs the skill layer MUST feed back into extraction for key REUSE. SINGLE SOURCE the Step-8 skills validate against. Sync-by-construction (no jsonschema dependency): src/citation_needed/review.py defines pydantic mirrors (OpenOutput / OpenArtifact / PriorChoice) with extra='forbid'; the CLI builds its output through them, and tests/test_review.py asserts each $defs entry's properties + required lists match the model's fields exactly, so this file and the code cannot drift.

run_id.description: The review_runs row id — pass it to `cite review commit --run <id>` (or as the payload's run_id).

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC, from the pipeline clock.

calibration_aged_accepted.description: True when this run was opened under the --accept-aged override of an over-30-day calibration (the override is also durably stamped onto the fingerprint cache as accepted_aged_at / accepted_aged_age_days). Downstream audit uses this to tell overridden runs from fresh-gate runs.

prior_choices.description: Every prior choice for this artifact (including status='removed' ones — reusing a removed key revives the same durable row), ordered by choice_key. Empty on a first review.

path.description: Two-scheme form: workspace-relative forward-slash, or memory:<project-dir-slug>/<file>.md.

content_hash.description: The artifact's stored current_content_hash, frozen onto the run as artifact_content_hash_at_review.

git_sha.description: Best-effort `git -C <workspace> rev-parse HEAD`; null when the workspace is not a git repo.

tool_schema_version.description: PRAGMA user_version the run was opened under.

status.description: Reuse the key for the same underlying decision even if reworded — including a removed key when the decision reappears.
